meta.description:
A single vast open chamber occupying nearly the whole floor, broken only by three staggered rows of stone pillars. The pillars create partial sightline breaks and         
  landmarks without ever sealing off a room, so a searcher can always see and reach every corner of the hall.
structural_rules: The entire interior (rows 1-8, cols 1-8) is open floor except for isolated single-cell pillars.
Pillars appear only as single '#' cells, never as walls of length 2+, so they never block a full row or column.
Pillars are arranged in three staggered rows (rows 2, 4, 6) at columns 3 and 6, creating a loose grid of landmarks.
No pillar touches another pillar, orthogonally or diagonally, preserving long unobstructed sightlines between them.
Rows 1, 3, 5, 7, 8 remain fully open with no pillars, giving clear horizontal sweep lines across the hall.
Outer border (row 0, row 9, col 0, col 9) is solid wall enclosing the open hall.
